description.narrative: Preparation for HCFC phase-out investment activities (stage II) (refrigeration and air-conditioning manufacturing sector) The objective of the HPMP - Stage II is to develop the second stage of a Compliance Strategy and corresponding Action Plan for the substances controlled under Annex C Group I (HCFCs) of the Montreal Protocol, for the period 2015 to 2020, such that the consumption of HCFCs is reduced by 35% from the baseline. Prep Fund: NIR/REF/72/PRP/137\ Tranche 1: NIR/PHA/81/INV/146
